Russia.narrative_differences: Official State Media focuses on diplomatic statements and domestic events such as the launch of the digital ruble, while Independent/Exiled Media emphasizes geopolitical tensions, international relations, and sanctions. Official State Media does not mention sanctions or geopolitical tensions explicitly, whereas Independent/Exiled Media highlights the lifting of sanctions from some Russian individuals and geopolitical incidents like the alleged violation of Polish airspace.
